title: Data Annotation Specialist
summary: Labels images, video, text and audio, and rates AI chatbot answers, so that companies can train and test AI models. Works in a delivery team at an AI data company or in-house data operations, following written guidelines and passing quality checks set by a team lead.
dailyDuties: Draw boxes and polygons on images in annotation tools
Tag text or transcribe audio clips to project rules
Rate and compare AI model answers and write feedback
Check a sample of peers' labels for errors
Flag unclear cases to the team lead with examples
Track daily output and accuracy in a sheet

skills.expectation: Label images with boxes, polygons and classes in tools such as CVAT or Label Studio
Follow labelling guidelines closely and check peers' work for errors
Tag text and transcribe or label audio to project rules
Rate and rank AI model answers and write feedback for training
Track counts, accuracy and issues in spreadsheets
Read English guidelines well and write clear notes on unclear cases
Judge edge cases sensibly against the guidelines and spot patterns in errors
Understand how the labels are used to train vision models
Understand how text labels feed language models
Know how chat assistants work to judge their answers
Write small scripts to check or convert label files
Log tool and guideline issues in Jira
